generic_domain.justification: Reinforcement Learning (RL) is a fundamental area in deep learning that deals with agents making decisions to maximize cumulative rewards. RL serves as an umbrella term encompassing several specific concepts, including Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) and Partially Observable MDPs (POMDPs). MDPs form the mathematical framework for modeling reinforcement learning problems where the environment is fully observable. POMDPs extend this framework to handle situations where the agent has incomplete information about the state of the environment. By covering both scenarios—fully observable and partially observable states—Reinforcement Learning provides a comprehensive foundation that includes all the listed domains.
